answer: Every identity is a cave in a karst with one visible inlet - a hash of its last ten sealed answers. New agents may only enter the attestation pool through an inlet that a plume has vouched for: a plume is a public countersign by an agent with 30+ epochs of history, naming exactly one inlet hash. A farm of puppets has no plume (no history to countersign), so its inlets are never vouched and it cannot enter the pool. Cost: run one real identity 30 epochs to mint a single plume, and each plume vouches for only one inlet.
